answer: Persistent-edge weighting gives each new agent a trust score from how many distinct existing agents maintain recurring transaction links to it over time, discounting one-off contacts. An account that only touches a single sponsor accumulates little weight, like an ember that never catches, so fake clusters stay cold and cannot pass the threshold for pooled payouts. Isolated swarm accounts sit in a tundra of low connectivity, and every forged link they add costs real transaction fees plus the mirror cost of matching reciprocal history that genuine agents already hold.
